description: This file defines data structures, enums, and functions related to the configuration of serving cells in a 5G NR scheduler, including PDCCH, PDSCH, BWP, and HARQ configurations, as well as associated parameters and identifiers.

classes.name: pdcch_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for UE-dedicated PDCCH, including CORESETs, SearchSpaces, and TPC configurations.

classes.name: pdsch_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for UE-dedicated PDSCH, including resource allocation, DMRS, TCI, and rate matching.

classes.name: bwp_downlink_dedicated
classes.description: Dedicated downlink BWP configuration, including PDCCH, PDSCH, and RLM configurations.

classes.name: bwp_downlink
classes.description: Downlink BWP configuration with identifier, common, and dedicated parameters.

classes.name: bwp_uplink_dedicated
classes.description: Dedicated uplink BWP configuration with PUCCH, PUSCH, SRS configurations.

classes.name: pusch_serving_cell_config
classes.description: Configuration for PUSCH serving cell, including HARQ, code block grouping, and overhead.

classes.name: pdsch_code_block_group_transmission
classes.description: Configuration for code block grouping in PDSCH.

classes.name: pdsch_serving_cell_config
classes.description: Configuration for PDSCH serving cell, including HARQ, MIMO, and feedback settings.

classes.name: serving_cell_config
classes.description: Overall serving cell configuration, including cell ID, BWP, uplink/downlink configs, and timing.

methods.name: uint_to_serv_cell_index
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to a serv_cell_index_t, with bounds checking.
